name: Montgomery Public Schools
calendarType: Board-approved four-page academic calendar with an MPS Vacation Planner and asynchronous-learning dates
seoDescription: Browse Montgomery Public Schools calendars by year, with verified MPS dates, remote-learning days, quarter schedules, official PDFs and calendar downloads.
districtFact: MPS publishes a four-page academic calendar that combines district dates, a family Vacation Planner and a color-coded month view. Its 2026–27 calendar distinguishes student days, teacher days, holidays and asynchronous-learning dates.

about.title: Asynchronous learning is not a day off
about.content: On MPS asynchronous-learning days, students work remotely while teachers report to school. These dates need a different family plan from holidays or teacher professional-development days when students do not attend.

about.title: Student and teacher breaks can end on different dates
about.content: The annual calendar publishes separate student and teacher ranges when their schedules differ. Each school-year page uses the student range for attendance and explains any staff day that changes the student return date.

about.title: The Vacation Planner includes adjacent weekends
about.content: MPS presents several breaks as three-, nine- or seventeen-day planning opportunities. Those totals include weekends around the official weekday closures, so the academic dates and the broader family-planning window are kept distinct.

about.title: Quarter totals and teacher days are published together
about.content: The MPS calendar reports quarter day counts as well as annual student and teacher totals. The school-year page preserves those separate measures instead of presenting every printed total as a student-attendance count.

calendarNotes: Use the board-approved MPS academic calendar for districtwide dates. Asynchronous-learning days are instructional dates when students work remotely and teachers report to school. The Vacation Planner counts adjacent weekends when it describes longer family-planning windows. Central-office closures, teacher-only dates, Senior Exams, graduation and Summer School do not all apply to every student. A MySchoolDates ICS file is a one-time import and does not update automatically.

districtFaqs.q: What does an MPS asynchronous-learning day mean?
districtFaqs.a: Students complete schoolwork remotely while teachers report to school. It is an instructional date, not a holiday or a districtwide no-school day.

districtFaqs.q: Why is an MPS Vacation Planner window longer than the listed school break?
districtFaqs.a: The Vacation Planner includes adjacent weekends when it counts a three-, nine- or seventeen-day opportunity. The school calendar's weekday closure dates remain the official break dates.
